title: Ali Ali Akbar
body:
Ali ali akber ali ali ..(2)
Shabihe payamber ali ali..(2)
Aye janaa
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Nazar uthake tou maa ko dekho aye beta (aye janaa)
Kyu sar jhukake khade huwe ho aye beta(aye jana)
Tumhi tou madar ka aasra ho aye beta
Aye jaane madar,(ali ali) ..(2)
shabihe payamber, ali ali..(2)
ali ali akber ,ali ali..(2)
shabihe payamber ,ali ali..(2)
(aye janaaa)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Nabi ki surat nabi ki sirat aye akber, aye jana
Nisar tumpe jaha ki azmat aye akber ,aye jana
Pukarti hai tumhe shahadat aye akber
Aye gule hyder ,ali ali ..(2)
Shabihe payamber, ali ali..(2)
Ali ali akber ,ali ali..(2)
Shabihe payamber ,ali ali..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Aye mere yusuf jamale akber ruk jao ,aye janam
Na jee sakegi tumhari madar ruk jao, aye janam
Sahenge kaise ye daagh sarwar ruk jao
Ruko aye Safder ,ali ali..(2)
Shabihe payamber ,ali ali..(2)
ali ali akber, Ali ali..(2)
shabihe payamber,ali ali..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Pidar ki aankhou ka noor ho tum aye dilber ,aye jana
Suna hai zakhmo se choor ho tum aye dilber, aye jana
Kyu haaye madar se door ho tum aye dilber ,aye jana
Dua e madar,  ali ali..(2)
Shabihe payamber, ali ali..(2)
Ali ali akber ali ali..(2)
shabihe payamber ali ali..(2)
aye janaa
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Hai umme laila ke labpe nouha wawaila, aye jana
lahoo me dooba hai laal mera wawaila ,aye jana
Huwa hai seene ke paar naiza wawaila
Fida ho madar ,ali ali ..(2)
Shabihe payamber ,ali ali..(2)
Ali ali akber ,ali ali ..(2)
Shabihe payamber, ali ali..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Gale ajal ko lagarahe ho maqtal me, aye jana
Charaagh khoon se jala rahe ho maqtal me ,aye jana
Yazeediyat ko mita rahe ho maqtal me
Bulaaye madar ,ali Ali..(2)
Shabihe payamber, ali ali..(2)
Ali ali akber, ali ali ..(2)
Shabihe payamber, ali ali ..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Hai khoo ki pyasi ye fouje ada ajao, aye jana
Utaare zainab tumhara sadqa ajao, aye jana
Hai zakhm seene me kitna gehra dikhlao
Aye mere dilber, ali ali..(2)
Shabihe payamber, ali ali..(2)
Ali ali akber ali ali ..(2)
Shabihe payamber ali ali..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Batao kaamil likhoo mai kaise wo manzar ,aye jana
Bapa tha karbobala me haaye wo mehshar ,aye jana
Uthaaye lasha kamer qameeda ye sarwer
Sadaaye Akber, ali ali ..(2)
Shabihe payamber, ali ali..(2)
Ali ali akber, ali ali..(2)
Shabihe payamber ,ali ali..(2)
